name: specpulse
description: SpecPulse: build React UI from natural language - LLM turns free text into a declarative UI spec, then compiles it to React components

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix preview run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
scripts.desktop: node scripts/kill-dev.mjs && cd desktop && npm run typecheck && npm run build && ./node_modules/.bin/electron .
